## 自检清单 / Self-review Checklist

> 单人开发时，PR 不需要等待他人审批，但这份清单帮助你在合并前做一次自我复查。  
> As a solo developer you don't need someone else's approval — this checklist is a quick self-review before merging.

- [ ] 代码在本地运行通过 / Code runs locally without errors
- [ ] 已通过 CI 检查 / CI checks pass
- [ ] 相关文档（README / CHANGELOG）已同步更新 / Docs updated if needed
- [ ] 没有遗留调试代码或硬编码密钥 / No leftover debug code or hardcoded secrets
- [ ] commit message 遵循 Conventional Commits 格式 / Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
